---
name: Review note
about: Something to change, check, or take out
title: ''
labels: review
---

**Where.** Page, scene name, or the words around it.


**What is wrong.** Or what you are not sure about. Both are useful.


**What it should say.** If you know. If you do not, say that too.


**How urgent.** Fix before anyone teaches it, or fix when there is time.
